notes: LIVE 3.2 recording: the parent completes delegation turn 1 before the child completes. DSH then delivers the child result as one agent-message relay and one subagent-settled notice, each causing a normal completed parent follow-up turn. The transcript contract pins those delivery records instead of incorrectly requiring only one parent turn. Lifecycle phases require the linked bare-UUID child, a 30-second parent hold, child ready, then parent ready. The driver polls the durable child turn/end and the daemon session snapshot; it does not use a trailing sleep.
